title: A Chef's Interview
text:
Maria is a chef. Yesterday she had an interview with a local newspaper. The reporter asked her about her favorite food. Maria said that she loves cooking soup for her family on cold days.

The reporter also asked about her plans for the future. Maria said she wants to open a small restaurant next year. She hopes that people will enjoy her simple and healthy meals.

questions.text: What does Maria want to open next year?
Why did Maria most likely enjoy the interview?
options: She liked talking about her cooking and her plans
She did not like the reporter
She wanted to leave the interview early

questions.text: What kind of meals does Maria probably make?

vocabulary.definition: a meeting where someone asks a person questions
a person whose job is cooking food in a restaurant
a place where people buy and eat meals

paragraph_translations: Maria é chef de cozinha. Ontem ela teve uma entrevista com um jornal local. O repórter perguntou sobre a comida favorita dela. Maria disse que adora cozinhar sopa para a família em dias frios.

O repórter também perguntou sobre os planos dela para o futuro. Maria disse que quer abrir um pequeno restaurante no próximo ano. Ela espera que as pessoas gostem de suas refeições simples e saudáveis.
